dedupe_keys.name: mobility demand mesh grid datasets for chicago bike sharing and taxis 2013 to 2020

description: This dataset turns Chicago's public bike-share and taxi trip records into ready-to-use tables for spatio-temporal forecasting of mobility demand. Flat tables count the bike rides starting at every bike station and the taxi trips starting in every taxi zone per 15-minute interval from 2013 to 2020 (280,512 timestamps), with min-max normalised versions; mesh-grid versions map the normalised counts onto a 90 by 60 grid over the city for bikes and taxis, and station locations, grid locations, taxi zone centroids and a holiday calendar are included. It was published by Ignacio-Iker Prado-Rujas of the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (version 1.0 of 6 August 2021). Coverage is city scale for Chicago at station, zone and grid-cell level. The HDF5 and CSV files (about 2.4 GB in total, the taxi mesh-grid alone 1.6 GB) are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the record does not name the source trip records or their terms, normalisation uses the period maximum, and the 2020 values reflect the pandemic. The data support network flow and capacity planning studies of bike-share and taxi services and the calibration of demand models, alongside the bus and bike trajectory datasets catalogued here.
name: Mobility demand mesh-grid datasets for Chicago bike sharing and taxis (2013 to 2020)

sources.note: creator Prado-Rujas (UPM); CC BY 4.0; version 1.0 of 2021-08-06; file descriptions (15-minute counts 2013-2020, 280,512 timestamps, normalisation, 90x60 mesh grids); file sizes
